project: kcl/thttpserver — a minimal HTTP server on kklass with GNU netcat as the network backend; kcl addition with own names (THttpRequest, THttpResponse, THttpRouter, THttpRouteObject, THttpServer, THttpApplication) plus a transport seam (THttpTransport, TNetcatTransport with two pre-spawned listener slots, TReplayTransport). FPC fcl-web is a design reference only. Goal: demonstrate kklass, not a full web server.
status: PLANNED, critic-hardened — PLAN.md written 2026-09-27, D6–D9 added and a critic pass folded in 2026-09-28 (3 blockers, 11 majors, 12 minors, nits; PLAN §8); no code.

decisions.D1: own kcl names: kcl/thttpserver, THttp* classes; FPC fcl-web is a design reference only (recommendation was FPC-anchored kcl/fphttpserver — overruled)
decisions.D2: GNU netcat only + TReplayTransport test double
decisions.D4: AcceptIdleTimeout default 0 (off, as FPC); tests always set 1000 ms
decisions.D5: pre-spawn the next listener right after the current request line arrives, in P2; two FIFO-backed slots (bash allows one coproc); fallback to a single coproc listener if the FIFO mechanics prove unreliable on msys — owner to be told — critic 2026-09-28: feasible only with an O_WRONLY writer, the child closing the other slot's fds, a cat stdin relay and a drained close (PLAN §2.5); re-verified by the supervisor 3/3 on both bashes
decisions.D6: request fields are read-only properties over private fields (property X read _x); generalised by critic C7 to every field another object reads. Measured: a plain var of another object read directly prints and leaves RESULT unchanged (stale); a property read is silent + RESULT; a write to a read-only property is rc 1 with kklass's own stderr line
decisions.D7: RegisterRoute PATTERN METHOD HANDLER [ISDEFAULT [DATA]] (with >=3 args the 2nd is always METHOD); route object gets DATA in RouteData, function / inst.method handler as $3; stored in ${inst}_rdat (never _data)
decisions.D8: an abstract route class is refused at registration with rc 2, by reading ${CLASS}_class_abstract (the flag .new checks) — no probe instance (critic C17); roadmap note: a public kk.isAbstract in kklass
decisions.D9: THttpApplication.ServerClass (default THttpServer) so a descendant server plugs in; non-server class -> Initialize rc 2

planning_measurements.nc: GNU netcat 0.7.1 in msys64 (bash 5.3.9 PATH); none on the bash 5.2.37 PATH — msys64 nc.exe by absolute path works from 5.2.37
planning_measurements.coproc_cycle: coproc nc -l -c -s 127.0.0.1 -p PORT; handler in the parent shell, state persists across requests (3/3), both bashes
planning_measurements.one_nc_many_clients: impossible with GNU 0.7.1: no -k; client 2 refused while the process lives on
planning_measurements.port_released_on_accept: nc #2 binds the same port while nc #1's accepted connection is still open, and receives client 2
planning_measurements.busy_port: rc 1 after ~74 ms, stderr 'Error: Couldn't setup listening socket (err=-3)'
planning_measurements.throughput: ~100 ms per request end-to-end (20 sequential curl requests, 5.3.9)
planning_measurements.object_cost: ~2.7 ms per request for object + TDictionary lifecycle, both bashes
planning_measurements.bytes: under C.UTF-8 ${#s} and read -N count characters; local LC_ALL=C counts bytes
planning_measurements.proxy: HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY=127.0.0.1:2080 on this machine — curl --noproxy '*' required
planning_measurements.fifo_rdwr_writer: 5.3.9: O_RDWR writer → nc never sees EOF after close, -c never fires (forbidden)
planning_measurements.fifo_wronly_writer: O_WRONLY → nc exits ~100 ms after close, client EOF ~32 ms, no open deadlock
planning_measurements.fifo_on_5_2: a Git-runtime FIFO as msys64 nc's stdin → 'select(core_readwrite): Bad file descriptor' on accept; < <(exec cat FIFO) relay fixes it
planning_measurements.fd_inheritance: pre-spawned listener inherits the live writer unless its child closes the other slot's fds
planning_measurements.working_variant: O_WRONLY + child closes other slot + cat relay + drained close: 3/3 on each bash (supervisor re-run 2026-09-28), 6/6 runs in critic probes incl. overlap; spawn 34-46 ms with relay, close 14-57 ms
planning_measurements.nc_w: -w limits accept only (not an accepted connection)
planning_measurements.nc_vv: 'Listening on IP PORT', 'Connection from IP:PORT', 'Listen mode failed: Connection timed out', 'Couldn't setup listening socket (err=-3)', 'Total received bytes: N'
planning_measurements.empty_assoc_key: a[$k]=1 with k='' aborts the whole top-level command (supervisor re-verified)
planning_measurements.printf_T_tz: local TZ ignored by %(...)T; TZ=UTC0 printf prefix works; names localized unless LC_ALL=C
planning_measurements.read_quirks: read -N does not count a dropped NUL; read -t 0 = rc 1 at once; -t -1 = error
planning_measurements.inherited_in_methods: bare inherited in a method passes no args; inherited in a destructor without a parent destructor = rc 127
planning_measurements.curl_expect: curl sends Expect: 100-continue only for bodies > 1 MiB
